verses.original: מִ֥י הֶאֱמִ֖ין לִשְׁמֻעָתֵ֑נוּ עַל־ מִ֥י וּזְר֥וֹעַ יְהוָ֖ה נִגְלָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: mî he·’ĕ·mîn liš·mu·‘ā·ṯê·nū ‘al- mî ū·zə·rō·w·a‘ Yah·weh niḡ·lā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Who has believed our message And to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַל לְפָנָ֗יו כַּיּוֹנֵ֜ק וְכַשֹּׁ֙רֶשׁ֙ צִיָּ֔ה מֵאֶ֣רֶץ לֹא־ תֹ֥אַר ל֖וֹ הָדָ֑ר וְנִרְאֵ֥הוּ וְלֹֽא־ וְלֹ֣א מַרְאֶ֖ה וְנֶחְמְדֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al lə·p̄ā·nāw kay·yō·w·nêq wə·ḵaš·šō·reš ṣî·yāh mê·’e·reṣ lō- ṯō·’ar lōw hā·ḏār wə·nir·’ê·hū wə·lō- wə·lō mar·’eh wə·neḥ·mə·ḏê·hū
verses.literal: He grew up before Him like a tender shoot and like a root out of dry ground He had no [stately] form or majesty to attract us no - beauty that we should desire Him

verses.original: נִבְזֶה֙ וַחֲדַ֣ל אִישִׁ֔ים אִ֥ישׁ מַכְאֹב֖וֹת וִיד֣וּעַ חֹ֑לִי וּכְמַסְתֵּ֤ר מִמֶּ֔נּוּ פָּנִים֙ נִבְזֶ֖ה חֲשַׁבְנֻֽהוּ׃ וְלֹ֥א
verses.transliteration: niḇ·zeh wa·ḥă·ḏal ’î·šîm ’îš maḵ·’ō·ḇō·wṯ wî·ḏū·a‘ ḥō·lî ū·ḵə·mas·têr mim·men·nū pā·nîm niḇ·zeh ḥă·šaḇ·nu·hū wə·lō
verses.literal: He was despised and rejected by men a man of sorrows acquainted with grief Like one from whom men hide . . . their faces He was despised and we esteemed Him not

verses.original: אָכֵ֤ן ה֣וּא נָשָׂ֔א חֳלָיֵ֙נוּ֙ סְבָלָ֑ם וּמַכְאֹבֵ֖ינוּ וַאֲנַ֣חְנוּ חֲשַׁבְנֻ֔הוּ נָג֛וּעַ מֻכֵּ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים וּמְעֻנֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḵên hū nā·śā ḥo·lā·yê·nū sə·ḇā·lām ū·maḵ·’ō·ḇê·nū wa·’ă·naḥ·nū ḥă·šaḇ·nu·hū nā·ḡū·a‘ muk·kêh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·mə·‘un·neh
verses.literal: Surely He took up our infirmities and carried our sorrows yet we considered Him stricken struck down by God and afflicted

verses.original: וְהוּא֙ מְחֹלָ֣ל מִפְּשָׁעֵ֔נוּ מְדֻכָּ֖א מֵעֲוֺנֹתֵ֑ינוּ מוּסַ֤ר שְׁלוֹמֵ֙נוּ֙ עָלָ֔יו וּבַחֲבֻרָת֖וֹ נִרְפָּא־ לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū mə·ḥō·lāl mip·pə·šā·‘ê·nū mə·ḏuk·kā mê·‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·nū mū·sar šə·lō·w·mê·nū ‘ā·lāw ū·ḇa·ḥă·ḇu·rā·ṯōw nir·pā- lā·nū
verses.literal: But He was pierced for our transgressions He was crushed for our iniquities the punishment that brought us peace was upon Him and by His stripes we are healed

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֙נוּ֙ כַּצֹּ֣אן תָּעִ֔ינוּ אִ֥ישׁ פָּנִ֑ינוּ לְדַרְכּ֖וֹ וַֽיהוָה֙ הִפְגִּ֣יעַ בּ֔וֹ אֵ֖ת עֲוֺ֥ן כֻּלָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lā·nū kaṣ·ṣōn tā·‘î·nū ’îš pā·nî·nū lə·ḏar·kōw Yah·weh hip̄·gî·a‘ bōw ’êṯ ‘ă·wōn kul·lā·nū
verses.literal: We all like sheep have gone astray each one has turned to his own way and the LORD has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all

verses.original: נִגַּ֨שׂ וְה֣וּא נַעֲנֶה֮ וְלֹ֣א יִפְתַּח־ פִּיו֒ יוּבָ֔ל כַּשֶּׂה֙ לַטֶּ֣בַח וּכְרָחֵ֕ל לִפְנֵ֥י גֹזְזֶ֖יהָ נֶאֱלָ֑מָה וְלֹ֥א יִפְתַּ֖ח פִּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: nig·gaś wə·hū na·‘ă·neh wə·lō yip̄·taḥ- pîw yū·ḇāl kaś·śeh laṭ·ṭe·ḇaḥ ū·ḵə·rā·ḥêl lip̄·nê ḡō·zə·ze·hā ne·’ĕ·lā·māh wə·lō yip̄·taḥ pîw
verses.literal: He was oppressed . . . and afflicted yet He did not open His mouth He was led like a lamb to the slaughter and as a sheep before her shearers is silent so He did not open His mouth

verses.original: מֵעֹ֤צֶר וּמִמִּשְׁפָּט֙ לֻקָּ֔ח וְאֶת־ מִ֣י יְשׂוֹחֵ֑חַ דּוֹר֖וֹ כִּ֤י נִגְזַר֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֔ים נֶ֥גַע מִפֶּ֥שַׁע עַמִּ֖י לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·‘ō·ṣer ū·mim·miš·pāṭ luq·qāḥ wə·’eṯ- mî yə·śō·w·ḥê·aḥ dō·w·rōw kî niḡ·zar mê·’e·reṣ ḥay·yîm ne·ḡa‘ mip·pe·ša‘ ‘am·mî lā·mōw
verses.literal: By oppression and judgment He was taken away and who can recount His descendants For He was cut off from the land of the living He was stricken for the transgression of My people

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן קִבְר֔וֹ אֶת־ רְשָׁעִים֙ וְאֶת־ עָשִׁ֖יר בְּמֹתָ֑יו עַ֚ל עָשָׂ֔ה לֹא־ חָמָ֣ס וְלֹ֥א מִרְמָ֖ה בְּפִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên qiḇ·rōw ’eṯ- rə·šā·‘îm wə·’eṯ- ‘ā·šîr bə·mō·ṯāw ‘al ‘ā·śāh lō- ḥā·mās wə·lō mir·māh bə·p̄îw
verses.literal: He was assigned a grave with the wicked and with a rich man in His death although He had done no violence nor was any deceit in His mouth

verses.original: וַיהוָ֞ה חָפֵ֤ץ דַּכְּאוֹ֙ הֶֽחֱלִ֔י אִם־ נַפְשׁ֔וֹ תָּשִׂ֤ים אָשָׁם֙ יִרְאֶ֥ה זֶ֖רַע יַאֲרִ֣יךְ יָמִ֑ים וְחֵ֥פֶץ יְהוָ֖ה יִצְלָֽח׃ בְּיָד֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ḥā·p̄êṣ dak·kə·’ōw he·ḥĕ·lî ’im- nap̄·šōw tā·śîm ’ā·šām yir·’eh ze·ra‘ ya·’ă·rîḵ yā·mîm wə·ḥê·p̄eṣ Yah·weh yiṣ·lāḥ bə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: Yet it was the LORD’s will to crush Him and to cause Him to suffer and when His soul is made a guilt offering He will see [His] offspring He will prolong His days and the good pleasure of the LORD will prosper in His hand

verses.original: מֵעֲמַ֤ל נַפְשׁוֹ֙ יִרְאֶ֣ה יִשְׂבָּ֔ע בְּדַעְתּ֗וֹ צַדִּ֛יק עַבְדִּ֖י יַצְדִּ֥יק לָֽרַבִּ֑ים ה֥וּא יִסְבֹּֽל׃ וַעֲוֺנֹתָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: mê·‘ă·mal nap̄·šōw yir·’eh yiś·bā‘ bə·ḏa‘·tōw ṣad·dîq ‘aḇ·dî yaṣ·dîq lā·rab·bîm hū yis·bōl wa·‘ă·wō·nō·ṯām
verses.literal: After the anguish of His soul He will see [the light of life] and be satisfied By His knowledge My righteous Servant will justify many and He will bear their iniquities

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֲחַלֶּק־ ל֣וֹ בָרַבִּ֗ים יְחַלֵּ֣ק שָׁלָל֒ וְאֶת־ עֲצוּמִים֮ תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶעֱרָ֤ה נַפְשׁ֔וֹ לַמָּ֙וֶת֙ נִמְנָ֑ה וְאֶת־ פֹּשְׁעִ֖ים וְהוּא֙ נָשָׂ֔א חֵטְא־ רַבִּ֣ים יַפְגִּֽיעַ׃ס וְלַפֹּשְׁעִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ă·ḥal·leq- lōw ḇā·rab·bîm yə·ḥal·lêq šā·lāl wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·ṣū·mîm ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·rāh nap̄·šōw lam·mā·weṯ nim·nāh wə·’eṯ- pō·šə·‘îm wə·hū nā·śā ḥêṭ- rab·bîm yap̄·gî·a‘ wə·lap·pō·šə·‘îm
verses.literal: Therefore I will allot Him a portion . . . with the great and He will divide the spoils with the strong because - He has poured out His life unto death and He was numbered with the transgressors Yet He bore the sin of many and made intercession for the transgressors
